description: Move one of the client's own appointments (id from my_bookings) to another open time for the same service. Check the new time with pro_open_times and confirm with the client first. This MOVES the booking; never book a second one to reschedule. Not possible within 2 hours of the time — then the client contacts the pro.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "tomorrow", in the pro's time zone.

name: reschedule_my_booking
title: Move one of your appointments to another time
